objective_value: <float> Makespan, the completion time of the job in the last sequence position on the last machine.
sequence: <list[int], length n_jobs> Permutation of jobs giving the order in which jobs enter every machine, where the k-th entry is the job placed in position k.
completion_times: <dict, key: 'machine_{machine_index}'> Completion time of the job in each sequence position on the given machine, given as a list of length n_jobs ordered by position.
